claims: The composite DTM combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys and resamples them for broad coverage.
Individual surveys contributing to the composite are stated as having vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15 centimetres RMSE.
A DTM models terrain rather than surface objects and must not be interchanged with a DSM.
The 1 metre composite DTM is publicly accessible without public access constraints.
Composite lineage represents a best-available mosaic and does not imply a uniform acquisition date across every cell.
WCS delivery is the numeric coverage route; visual map services are not a substitute for raster value readback.
WCS GeoTIFF output uses NoData value -3.4028235e+38.
NoData must be excluded before any elevation or difference calculation.
Time Stamped Tiles preserve survey-specific raster chronology.
Survey date and composite precedence must be retained when comparing candidate cells.

quality_guards: Do not treat composite coverage as one survey epoch.
Do not promote a WMS colour or rendered pixel to a numeric elevation.
Reject NoData sentinel values before statistics or height differences.
Fail closed until the exact TQ2892 filtered metadata, GeoTIFF bytes and candidate cell values are captured.
evidence_digest_policy: GitHub remote blob SHA readback after publish
